medidor_anterior.description: Use when the physical meter was replaced: enter which sensor was used before and until when. Before that date the previous sensor counts; from it on, the current one.

The cut falls on the full hour.

rateio.title: Credit distribution
rateio.description: {situacao} How much of the surplus energy goes to each unit; they must add up to 100%.

data_description.a_partir_de:
Blank, the new distribution applies from now; with a future date, it is scheduled. Earlier months keep the distribution in force at the time.

**History:** {historico}

tarifa.title: Tariff
tarifa.description: Energy tariff before taxes, per kWh, used to estimate the open cycle while the bill has not arrived. Each tariff applies from its date until the next one: entering a new one does not change earlier months.

data_description.valor: Entered: {atuais}. To delete one, pick its date and leave the value blank.

investimento.title: Solar system investment
investimento.description: How much the solar system cost and when it was paid. This is what enables the payback.

horario.title: Reading boundary time
horario.description: The time of day used to align the bill reading dates with the sensors. Changing it recalculates all cycle history.

error.second_generator: Another unit already generates energy. Only one unit can generate: untick "generates energy" on it first.

error.shares_total: The percentages must add up to exactly 100%.
error.share_invalid: Each percentage must be between 0 and 100.
error.distribution_refused: The distribution was not accepted. If one is already scheduled for the future it must take effect first; and scheduling needs a current distribution.
error.image_invalid: The picture could not be used. Send a JPG, PNG or WebP up to 12 MB.
error.swap_when_invalid: Enter the date and time the meter was replaced.
error.swap_refused: The swap was refused: the date must be after the current meter started, and the new sensor must differ from the current one.
error.amount_invalid: Enter an amount greater than zero, e.g. 25000.00.
error.tariff_invalid: Enter the tariff per kWh, greater than zero, e.g. 0.65.
error.history_keep: This quantity already had a meter replaced and cannot be left without a sensor: the record of previous meters depends on it.
error.previous_incomplete: To record the previous meter, fill in the three fields: quantity, previous sensor and until when.
error.previous_needs_current: This quantity has no current sensor yet. Pick its current sensor in the field above.
error.previous_same: The previous sensor is the same as the current one.
error.unit_without_meter: This unit is marked as having no meter in Home Assistant. To add sensors, tick "This unit has a meter in Home Assistant" under Edit a unit.
error.unit_has_share: This unit holds {percentual}% of the distribution. Set it to zero under "Credit distribution" before deleting it — otherwise the others stop adding up to 100%.

abort.faturas_no_painel:
PDF bills are read in the **Gestão de Energia** panel, in the sidebar: **Configuração** tab → **Extração de faturas**.

Pick the folder with the PDFs: the panel reads them all at once and shows which unit each one belongs to. Read as many as you have — each old bill becomes a month in the history.

The PDF is not kept in Home Assistant, only the numbers of the bill.
